edits.old: The contract serves two screens without owning either: SCR-02 Case list (states Loading; empty; list; error) through `GET /queues/{queueId}/cases`, and the my-work view of the officer (states Loading; empty; list; error) through `GET /me/tasks`. The task update screen state (saving; saved; conflict; error) is driven by `PATCH /tasks/{taskId}`. Both screens are reached through the gateway-bff composite route (DP-19); the contract fixes only the payloads and the error envelope, not the layout.

The task update screen state (saving; saved; conflict; error) is driven by `PATCH /tasks/{taskId}`. Both screens are reached through the gateway-bff composite route (DP-19); the contract fixes only the payloads and the error envelope, not the layout.
